description: This file contains utility classes and static methods for managing and checking permissions of team members within a system. It defines permission retrieval, validation, and role-based access control logic related to team member operations in a software project.

classes.name: TeamMemberPermissionChecks
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for retrieving permissions, checking access, and validating team member roles within a team management context.

methods.name: List[KeyManagementRoutes] get_permissions_for_team_member( team_member_object: Member, team_table: LiteLLM_TeamTableCachedObj, )
methods.description: Retrieves the list of permissions assigned to a team member, defaulting when none are explicitly set.

methods.name: List[str] _get_list_of_route_enum_as_str( route_enum: List[KeyManagementRoutes], )
methods.description: Converts a list of route enums into a list of their string values.

methods.name: can_team_member_execute_key_management_endpoint( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, route: KeyManagementRoutes, prisma_client: PrismaClient, user_api_key_cache: DualCache, existing_key_row: LiteLLM_VerificationToken, )
methods.description: Main method to verify whether a team member can perform key management operations, based on their permissions and role.

methods.name: Optional[bool] does_team_member_have_permissions_for_endpoint( team_member_object: Optional[Member], team_table: LiteLLM_TeamTableCachedObj, route: str, )
methods.description: Checks if a team member has permission to access a specific API endpoint; raises exception if not authorized.

methods.name: bool user_belongs_to_keys_team( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, existing_key_row: LiteLLM_VerificationToken, )
methods.description: Checks whether a user belongs to the team associated with a specific key.

methods.name: List[str] get_all_available_team_member_permissions()
methods.description: Lists all possible permissions that can be assigned to team members.

methods.name: List[str] default_team_member_permissions()
methods.description: Provides the default set of permissions for team members.
